dimensions.name: goal
dimensions.p: Install battery backup at Sablewick's three community sites within the £120,000 grant by 30 June 2026.
dimensions.f: Install battery backup at Sablewick's three community sites within the £120,000 grant by 30 June 2026.

dimensions.name: requirements
p: R1: Use the selected local installer; installation labour is included in the vendor quotes.
R2: No fossil-fuel backup may be installed.
R3: Site B is coastal and flood-exposed: only a vendor whose warranty covers coastal sites may be used there, and its published minimum operating temperature must be at or below -4 C.
R4: Site C is a listed building: the unit must be no wider than 800 mm.
R5: Keep at least 8% of committed cost as contingency.
